annotations.title: Async or network behavior changed
annotations.message: Async or network behavior changed because 2 added line(s) matched fetch, promise, async, timer, or abort controller code patterns. Suggested check: Check loading, failure, timeout, and empty-state behavior.

annotations.title: Implementation changed without matching test changes
annotations.message: Implementation changed without matching test changes because src/app.js, package.json changed and no test, spec, smoke, or __tests__ file changed. Suggested check: Run the closest available test or smoke check manually.

annotations.title: Routing or entry-point logic changed
annotations.message: Routing or entry-point logic changed because src/app.js matched routing, entry, main, index, or app path patterns. Suggested check: Manually test the affected navigation or app entry path.

unsupported.label: Dependency or config file changed
unsupported.reason: changed file has no added line to annotate
